questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, highlighters, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any working should be done in this booklet. Electronic calculators may be used. questions.questionText: A cyclist is travelling due south with velocity u. The wind is blowing from the north-east with velocity w. cyclist wind u w The wind has a velocity v relative to the cyclist, where v = w – u. Which vector diagram shows the magnitude and direction of velocity v?

options.A: B C D v v v v

questions.questionText: A student takes measurements of the current in a resistor of constant resistance and the potential difference (p.d.) across it. The readings are then used to plot a graph of current against p.d. There is a systematic error in the current readings. How could this be identified from the graph?

options.A: At least one anomalous data point can be identified.
options.B: The data points are scattered about the straight line of best fit.
options.C: The graph is a curve, not a straight line.
options.D: The straight line graph does not pass through the origin. Space for working

questions.questionText: The diagram shows the stem of a Celsius thermometer, marked to show initial and final temperature values. initial final temperature temperature –10 –5 0 +5 +10 +15 What is the temperature change expressed to an appropriate number of significant figures?

A double-ended launching device fires two identical steel balls X and Y at exactly the same time. The diagram shows the initial velocities of the balls. They are both launched horizontally, but Y has greater speed. launching device X Y Which statement explains what an observer would see?

options.A: Both X and Y reach the ground simultaneously, because air resistance will cause both to have the same final speed.
options.B: Both X and Y reach the ground simultaneously, because gravitational acceleration is the same for both.
options.C: X reaches the ground before Y, because X lands nearer to the launcher.
options.D: Y reaches the ground before X, because Y has greater initial speed. Space for working

options.A: It is equal to half the value of the gradient of the graph.

options.C: It is equal to twice the value of the gradient of the graph.
options.D: It is equal to the reciprocal of the gradient of the graph. Space for working

options.A: 1.3J B 1.6J C 2.6J D 3.2J Space for working

options.A: The average speed of the molecules in the ice is greater than the average speed of the molecules in the water.
